description: This Java source file defines the SparkplugNodeSessionHandler class, which manages MQTT sessions for Sparkplug nodes within the Thingsboard platform. It handles metrics, device attributes, telemetry, subscriptions, and session validation specific to Sparkplug protocol version 3.0.0.

classes.name: SparkplugNodeSessionHandler
classes.description: Manages MQTT sessions for Sparkplug nodes, handling metrics, attributes, telemetry, and subscriptions within the Thingsboard platform for Sparkplug protocol v3.0.0.

methods.name: setNodeBirthMetrics
methods.description: Sets the node's birth metrics from a list of Sparkplug metrics, ensuring each metric has a name and optional alias, and updating internal maps.

methods.name: onValidateNDEATH
methods.description: Validates NDEATH message by comparing sequence numbers to ensure proper session termination.

methods.name: onAttributesTelemetryProto
methods.description: Processes incoming Sparkplug payloads to update device attributes and telemetry, handling node and device-specific metrics.

methods.name: onDeviceTelemetryProto
methods.description: Processes telemetry messages for a device, sending telemetry data and handling failures.

methods.name: onDeviceAttributesProto
methods.description: Processes attribute messages for a device, validating and applying attribute updates.

methods.name: handleSparkplugSubscribeMsg
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, validating topics for Sparkplug data or status messages.

methods.name: onDeviceDisconnect
methods.description: Handles device disconnection events, performing cleanup or state updates.

methods.name: onDeviceConnectProto
methods.description: Establishes a device session context upon device connection, based on Sparkplug topic.

methods.name: convertToPostTelemetry
methods.description: Converts Sparkplug metrics into telemetry messages for posting to the platform.

methods.name: convertToPostAttributes
methods.description: Converts Sparkplug metrics into attribute messages for posting to the platform.

methods.name: createSparkplugMqttPublishMsg
methods.description: Creates MQTT publish messages from Sparkplug metrics and key-value pairs, validating data types.

methods.name: newDeviceSessionCtx
methods.description: Creates a new device session context for a device identified by a gateway response.

methods.name: sendToDeviceRpcRequest
methods.description: Sends an RPC request to a device via MQTT.

methods.name: sendErrorRpcResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response for an RPC request.

methods.name: validateTopicDataSubscribe
methods.description: Validates if a subscription topic matches Sparkplug data message patterns.
